site.legal.text.cookiesPolicy:
This policy explains how Betigo uses cookies and related technologies when you visit our platform, and your choices regarding them.
By accessing and continuing to use Betigo, you agree to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

Chapter 1: What Are Cookies?
Cookies are small text files stored on your device (e.g. computer, phone, tablet) that help record and recognize your browsing behavior.


Chapter 2: Why We Use Cookies
● Login authentication (account recognition)
● Preference storage (language, layout, etc.)
● Traffic analysis (user behavior tracking)
● Functionality support (pop-ups, animations)
● Marketing tracking (ad targeting and recommendations)


Chapter 3: Types of Cookies We Use
● Session Cookies (temporary)
● Persistent Cookies (saved preferences)
● Analytical Cookies (behavior analysis)
● Marketing Cookies (conversion tracking)


Chapter 4: Third-Party Cookies
We may allow trusted partners to set cookies, including advertising tools, payment providers, and analytics services.


Chapter 5: How to Manage or Delete Cookies
You can disable cookies through your browser settings (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Edge). Disabling cookies may affect some functionality.


Chapter 6: Updates and Notifications
This policy may be updated periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page.

Last Updated: May 5, 2025
site.legal.text.privacyPolicy:
Betigo respects and is committed to protecting the privacy of all users. This policy outlines how we collect, use, protect, and share your personal data. By registering or using the Betigo platform, you agree to all terms in this policy.

Chapter 1: Information We Collect
We may collect the following types of data based on your usage:
1.1 Registration and Account Information
● Name, date of birth, phone number, email, bank details, address, etc.

1.2 Usage and Transaction Records
● Login time, IP address, browsing behavior, betting history, deposits, and withdrawals.

1.3 Device and Technical Info
● Operating system, device type, device ID, browser type, and location (if permitted).

1.4 Customer Support Interaction
● Texts, images, audio, and call records when contacting support.


Chapter 2: How We Use Your Information
● Identity verification and account management
● Processing deposits, withdrawals, and transactions
● Providing personalized services and promotions
● Ensuring system security and fraud prevention
● Compliance with legal and auditing requirements
● Service improvement and data analysis


Chapter 3: Sharing & Disclosure
We do not sell, rent, or exchange your information with unauthorized third parties, except in the following cases:
● Authorized sharing with your consent
● Legal or court-ordered disclosures
● Necessary data sharing with third-party service providers
● Disclosure required to handle serious violations of platform rules


Chapter 4: Data Security
● SSL encryption, firewalls, and access controls protect your data.
● Employees are bound by confidentiality agreements and access only on a need-to-know basis.
● Regular security audits are conducted to prevent data leaks, loss, or misuse.


Chapter 5: Data Retention
● Your data will be retained while your account remains active. If you delete your account or are inactive for over 12 months, your data will be anonymized or deleted.
● Legal transaction records will be retained for at least 5 years to comply with regulations.


Chapter 6: Your Rights
You have the right to access/modify your data, close your account, opt out of marketing messages, or submit data requests.


Chapter 7: Policy Updates
We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. Changes will be announced on this page and take effect once published.

Last Updated: May 5, 2025
site.legal.text.termsConditions01:
Welcome to Betigo. Before using our services, please read the following Terms & Conditions carefully. By registering, logging in, or continuing to use our platform, you confirm that you fully understand and accept these terms.

Chapter 1: Account Registration & Usage
1.1 Age Restriction
● All users must be at least 18 years old or above the legal gambling age in their jurisdiction.
● The platform reserves the right to request identification for age verification. Accounts found to be fraudulently registered will be permanently banned.

1.2 Unique Account Policy
● Each user is allowed only one account. If duplicate accounts or fake identities are found, Betigo reserves the right to freeze all related accounts and forfeit balances or bonuses.

1.3 User Responsibility
● You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password, and for all actions taken through your account.
● If you suspect unauthorized use, please contact customer support immediately.


Chapter 2: Deposits & Withdrawals
2.1 Deposit Rules
● Users may only deposit via payment methods approved by the platform.
● All deposits must meet the minimum turnover requirement before withdrawals are allowed.

2.2 Withdrawal Rules
● Real-name verification and security checks are required before withdrawal.
● The platform may review transaction history to prevent money laundering or abuse.
● Betigo reserves the right to reject withdrawal requests and freeze accounts in case of suspicious activity.


Chapter 3: Games & Betting Rules
3.1 Fair Play
● All game outcomes on Betigo are generated using certified RNG systems to ensure fairness.
● Users may not use bots, cheats, or any method to manipulate gameplay.

3.2 Abnormal Bet Handling
● In the event of system errors, server delays, or third-party interruptions, the system records will be the final reference.
● The platform reserves the right to cancel or amend any abnormal results due to technical issues.


Chapter 4: Bonuses & Promotions
4.1 Claim Requirements
● All promotions are subject to terms stated on the event page, such as minimum deposits or turnover.
● Abuse of bonuses (e.g., multi-accounting) will result in disqualification and permanent ban.

4.2 Bonus Expiry
● Unused or incomplete bonus turnover within the validity period will automatically expire and will not be reissued.


Chapter 5: User Conduct & Platform Rights
5.1 Prohibited Activities
● Including but not limited to: abuse of bonuses, money laundering, harassing support staff, spreading false info, inducing registrations, or using illegal payment methods.
● Violations may lead to account suspension, balance confiscation, or legal action.

5.2 Service Modifications
● Betigo reserves the right to change terms, games, or promotions without prior notice.
● Continued use implies acceptance of the latest version of the terms.


Chapter 6: Legal Compliance & Dispute Resolution
● The platform operates in accordance with the laws of its server jurisdiction.
● Any disputes shall first be resolved through negotiation. If unsuccessful, the platform's designated arbitration body shall have the final say.

Last updated: 5 May 2025
site.support.text.commonProblem:
Account

Q: How do I register a Betigo account?
A: Just click [Register], fill in your username, phone number, password, and verification code. A referral code is required and will be filled in automatically. If not, feel free to contact our support team.

Q: Can I use the same phone number for multiple accounts?
A: Unfortunately, no. Each player is allowed one account only. Accounts detected as duplicates may be restricted.

Q: What should I do if I forget my password?
A: Simply click [Forgot Password] on the login page and follow the steps to reset it. If your account is frozen, please contact support for help.

Q: What happens if multiple accounts share the same bank, IP, or device?
A: To keep things fair, we only allow one account per user. If the system finds multiple accounts using the same bank, IP, or device, restrictions may apply.

Deposits & Withdrawals

Q: What payment methods does Betigo support?
A: We support local E- Wallets, Bank Transfers, and Crypto. All payments are fast, safe, and easy to use.

Q: How long does it take to withdraw?
A: Withdrawals are usually processed within 5–30 minutes. Please make sure your bank info is correct and under your real name.

Q: What should I do if my deposit or withdrawal fails?
A: Kindly double-check your details and make sure any turnover requirements are met. If you need help, our support team is always here for you.

Platform & Game Issues

Q: Why do I sometimes face errors when using the platform?
A: Due to the complexity of the platform and different user device environments, you may experience the following issues:

- Page or feature not displaying properly
- Deposit or withdrawal errors
- Login failures or disconnection
- Unexpected system error messages
- Buttons or links not responding

Don’t worry — our 24/7 technical support team is ready to help you resolve any of these issues promptly.
